caveats: "no match" means none found by this search, not proven absence

nodes.label: Ventilation & source capture
certainty_notes: School ventilation-absence evidence is observational (California 1.6%/L/s; Scotland small effect); no trials [MENDELL_VENT; GAIHRE_SCOT]
data_gaps: Small measured samples only (7 English homes, 70 California homes, 1 Finnish office); no intervention-linked health data
California 70-homes range hood + NO2 dataset needs browser download (Dryad 401); seven English homes have no room labels and uncalibrated NO2

nodes.label: Particle filtration
certainty_notes: Only small RCTs (e.g. HAPI, n=71, US): PM2.5 fell ~60% but primary asthma-control outcome not significant [HAPI_HEPA]
data_gaps: No UK school filtration dataset; SICAS (US) published null result only; China purifier data observational

nodes.label: Clean cooking
certainty_notes: HAPIN RCT (LMIC): LPG cut exposure but did not change birth weight, pneumonia or stunting - exposure reduction did not equal health gain [HAPIN]
data_gaps: No UK gas-to-induction switch trial with health outcomes; most graph evidence is solid fuel in LMICs
No UK figure found for share of homes cooking on gas, so EU/US attributable fractions (12-12.7% child asthma) cannot be scaled to UK

nodes.label: Moisture & mould remediation
certainty_notes: Cochrane (Sauni 2015): repair reduces adult asthma symptoms/infections but certainty moderate to very low; school evidence inconsistent [COCHRANE_MOULD]
data_gaps: No open dataset linking damp/mould remediation to health outcomes; EHS gives prevalence only

nodes.label: Radon mitigation
certainty_notes: No study measures health outcomes after mitigation; benefit is modelled from exposure-response (cost/QALY GBP 36.8k retrofit vs 11.4k new build) [GRAY_RADON]
data_gaps: No open building-level pre/post mitigation data; radon atlas licence not stated

nodes.label: Allergen & pest control
certainty_notes: Cochrane (Gotzsche 2008): single dust-mite control measures show no benefit; review flagged as out of date; multi-trigger programmes not reviewed [COCHRANE_HDM]
data_gaps: No open intervention dataset with health outcomes; SICAS IPM arm published only

nodes.label: Building fabric
certainty_notes: Health benefit concentrated in people with inadequate warmth/chronic respiratory disease; untargeted retrofit >GBP 100k/QALY (NICE model) [COCHRANE_WARMTH; NICE_NG6]
data_gaps: Few observed before/after retrofit energy + health datasets; EPC is modelled; heat-pump monitoring (EoH) access unverified
Retrofit quality is a hidden variable: NAO found 98% external / 29% internal wall insulation under ECO4/GBIS with major issues (damp & mould risk) - no health follow-up of affected homes

co_benefits.text: Damp risk if poorly installed: 98% EWI with major issues

nodes.label: Indoor temperature
data_gaps: Sparse measured overheating/comfort data; no cooling intervention health data for UK homes

co_benefits.text: US weatherization ~USD 14k health/household benefit per home
